name: imessage-mcp
description: Search and read your Apple Messages history. Read-only, runs on your Mac.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search messages by substring, exact text, token, or phrase.

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Read a conversation with edits, reactions, receipts, replies, and attachments.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: Find conversations by contact, service, kind, reply state, or date.

tools.name: get_attachment
tools.description: Show one attachment: images with metadata removed, text files as text.

tools.name: sync_messages
tools.description: Pull new, edited, unsent, and deleted messages, reactions, and receipts since a cursor.

tools.name: analyze_communication
tools.description: Message counts, activity, response times, and initiation.

tools.name: resolve_contact
tools.description: Match a name or handle to a contact without guessing.

tools.name: server_status
tools.description: Version, update availability, access, and index state.

privacy.title: Privacy mode
privacy.description: full, redacted, or aggregate. redacted shows names and masked handles with no message text; aggregate shows counts only.

contacts.title: Contact names
contacts.description: live reads your unified Contacts to name handles. none leaves handles unnamed.

update_check.title: Check for updates
update_check.description: When on, server status makes one anonymous request to the public npm registry to see whether a newer version exists. No message or contact data is sent.

long_description: Lets Claude search and read the iMessage, SMS, MMS, and RCS history already stored in Messages on your Mac: find messages, read conversations with edits and reactions, see photos with location data removed, follow new messages, and answer counts and response-time questions. It cannot send, edit, or delete messages. Everything runs locally; there are no accounts or telemetry. Claude needs Full Disk Access to read Messages.
